pada:
atha saptamo~adhyAyaH |
pAriSeShyAduttarabastimAha -
ataH paraM pravakShyAmi bastimuttarasaMj~jitam | 
dvAdaSA~ggulakaM netraM madhye ca kRutakarNikam || 1 ||
mAlatIpuShpavRuntABaM CidraM sarShapasanniBam |

vya_text: gU0 - ataH param uttarasaMj~jitaM bastiM pravakShyAmi pUrvaM vidhAnamAha - dvAdaSAMgulikaM netraM nAlikA lakShaNaM madhye kRutakarNikaM kamalapatrakarNikAvanmadhyaBAgaM mAlatIpuShpavRuntABaM sthUlaM punaH Cidre sarShapanirgamaM yathA Bavati tathA Cidram || 1 ||

dI0 - ataH paraM bastinirUhayoranantaram uttarasaMj~jitaM bastiM pravakShyAmi iti | uttarabastinetrasvarUpamAha - madhye ca kRutakarNikamiti | madhye ShaDa~ggulopari karNikA meKalAkArA mudrikA | ata eva mUtramArge ShaDa~ggulaM netraM praveSayedityuktamagre | yantracCidraM tu mAlatIpuShpavRuntABaM kAryaM sarShapAkAram | yantre CidramAha - CidraM sarShapasanniBaM nirgamacCidramityartha: | kecit ‘sarShapanirgamam’ iti pAThaM paThanti | siddhArthakapraveSAgramiti tantrAntare | nanu kvacidapi caturdaSAMgulamapi paThitaM tadyathA - ‘caturdaSA~ggulaM netraM tatra kAryaM vijAnatA | mAlatIpuShpavRuntABaM kartavyaM Cidrameva ca’ iti | tatkathamatra dvAdaSAMgulam ? ucyate, karNikArthaM tu netraM ShaDa~ggulameva sarvasaMmatam | SeShaM tu carmapuTakasya samIcInagrathanArthaM kathitamityadoShaH | carakAdau tu dvAdaSAMgulamevoktatvAt, athavA - ‘meDhrAyAmasamaM kecidicCanti Kalu tadvida’ ityAdi matamAlocya carakamatameva SAr~ggadhareNa svIkRutamityalaM vistareNa || 1 ||

pada:
snehamAtrAmAha -
pa~jcaviMSativarShANAmadho mAtrA dvikArShikA || 2 || 
tadUrdhvaM palamAtrA ca snehasyoktA BiShagvaraiH |

vya_text: gU0 - vayo~anumAnena pramANamAha - pa~jcaviMSativarShANAm adhovayasAM snehasya tailAderdvikArShikI palArdhamAnamAtrA, tadUrdhvaM pa~jcaviMSaterUrdhvaM snehasya palamAnA mAtrA || 2 ||

dI0 - pa~jcaviMSativarShANAmadhaH pa~jcaviMSativarShAdadho~arvAk caturviMSatiparyantaM mAtrA snehasya dvikArShikI | tadUrdhvaM pa~jcaviMSAdUrdhvaM palamAtrA | BiShagvarairiti grahaNena doShadeSadehakAlAnalAdyapekShya nyUnAdhikA~api mAtrA yojyA sampradAyadarSanAt | ata evoktaM -‘pa~jcaviMSativarShonamadho mAtrA dvikArShikI’ iti kvacitpATho~api || 2 ||

pada:
athottarabastervidhAnamAha -
athAsthApanaSuddhasya tRuptasya snAnaBojanaiH || 3 || 
sthitasya jAnumAtre ca pIThe~anviShya SalAkayA | 
snigdhayA meDhramArge ca tato netraM niyojayet || 4 || 
SanaiH SanairGRutAByaktaM meDhrarandhre~a~ggulAni ShaT |
tato~avapIDayedbastiM SanairnetraM ca nirharet || 5 || 
tataH pratyAgate snehe snehabastikramo hitaH |

vya_text: gU0 - athottarabastidAne yogyamAha - athAnantaram AsthApane tu nirUhaNena Suddhasya punaH snAnaBojanaistaptasya punaH jAnumAtre pIThe sthitasya iShTaSalAkayA snigdhayA kRutaM netramArgaM | tataH netram uttarabastinalikAM yojayet | SanaiH SanairGRutAByaktaM GRutavyAptaM netraM meDhrarandhre ShaT a~ggulAni yojyaM, bastinA pIDayet | punaH SanairnetraM nirharet niShkAsayet | tataH snehe pratyAgate ayaM snehabastikramaH hitaH kathitaH || 3-5 ||

dI0 - athaSabda Anantarye | AsthApanaM kaShAyabastiH, kaShAyairdIyamAnatvAt | nirUhamevAsthApanakamityeke | kasya ? snAnaBojanaiH tRuptasya, BojanagrahaNena GRutakShIramAMsAdInAM grahaNam | uktaM ca - ‘athAntaramupasnigdhaM svinnaM praSithilASayam | yavAnnaM saGRutaM kShIraM pItavantaM yathAbalam’ ityAdi | jAnumAtre pIThe iti jAnuparimANe Asane | uccatayA boddhavyam | uktaM ca -‘niShaNNamAjAnusame pIThe’ ityAdi | anviShya SalAkayA iti meDhramArgaM SalAkayA anviShya anveShaNaM kRutvA | kiMviSiShTayA SalAkayA snigdhayA SlakShNayA | athavA GRutABya~jjanena vA | tato netraM niyojayet iti | netraM nalikA uttarabastisaMj~jasya |‘athAsthApanaSuddhasya tRuptasya snAnaBojanaiH’ asyAgre - ‘svaByaktabastiSIrShasya tailenoShNena yuktitaH | tataH samaM sthApayitvA nAlamasya praharShitam’ ityeke paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca, prAcInapustake na dRuShTaH |
atha yantrapIDanamAha - netraM yantraM GRutAByaktaM ShaDa~ggulaM meDhrarandhre meDhramArge praveSayedvaidya iti SeShaH | ata evoktaM prAk ‘madhye ca kRutakarNikam’ iti | tena karNikAparyantaM sasnigdhaM meDhramArge praveSayedityarthaH | tato~anantaraM praveSAnantaraM bastiM snehAdisaMBRutaM carmapuTakaM SanairyathAsyAdavapIDyate yathA~antaH sneho~antaH praviShTo Bavati | netraM ca harediti | punaH SanairyathA syAttathA netraM haret mUtramArgAdityarthaH | snehe pratyAgate snehabastikramaH hitaH | ‘snehabastikramo hita’ ityasya sthAne -‘aparAhNe vicakShaNaH | payasA BojayedenaM yUShairmAMsarasena vA’ iti kecit, tadapi yuktaM tantrAntarasaMvAdAt | ‘snehakramo hita’ iti tatra granthakarturayamASayaH - tatra samyagdattasya li~ggAni Bavanti, vyApadaSca tAH | tatratyopakramaSca kartavyaH | uktaM ca - ‘samyagdattasya li~ggAni vyApadaH krama eva ca | basteruttarasaMj~jasya samAnaH snehabastinA’ iti ||3-5 ||

pada:
puMsAmuttarabastinetramuktvA strINAmuttarabastimAha -
strINAM kaniShThikAsthUlanetraM kuryAddaSAMgulam || 6 || 
mudgapraveSayogyaM ca yonyantaScatura~ggulam |
dvya~ggulaM mUtramArge ca sUkShmaM netraM niyojayet || 7 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha strINAM bastidAne vidhimAha -- strINAmiti sugamam || 6 || 7 ||

dI0 - kaniShThikA striya eva | daSA~ggulamiti | dairGyeNa mudgapraveSaM randhramiti SeShaH | tena mudgavAhinalikAcCidramityarthaH | yonyantaScatura~ggulamiti | tacca netramatyarthamArge catura~ggulapramANamantaH praveSayedityarthaH | uktaM ca - mUtrasrotaHparINAhamudgavAhidaSA~ggulam | tAsAmatyarthamArge tu nidadhyAccatura~ggulam’ iti | dvya~ggulaM mUtramArge ca iti | strINAmatra mUtramArge j~jeyam | tatra dvya~ggulanetraM praveSayediti BAvaH | tacca sUkShmanetraM kAryaM yathA puruShameDhramArgArthaM mAlatIpuShpavRuttABaM kathitaM tadvadatrA~api j~jeyam || 6 || 7 ||

pada:
bAlAnAmapi netraparimANamAha -
mUtrakRucCravikAreShu bAlAnAM tvekama~ggulam |
SanairniShkampamAdheyaM sUkShmanetraM vicakShaNaH || 8 ||

vya_text: gU0 - atha bAlAnAM bastidAnapramANamAha - mUtrakRucCreti sugamam || 8 ||

dI0 - mUtrakRucCravikAreShu iti padaM pUrveNa saMbandhanIyam | bAlAnAmapi vA mUtrakRucCravikAre~api bAlaH ‘ShoDaSavarShaparyanto bAlaH’ ekama~ggulaM netreNa saMbandhanIyam | sUkShmanetramityanena mAlatIpuShpavRuttAkAratvAt sUkShmatvaM j~jeyam || 8 ||

pada:
athApatyamUtramArgayorviShayatvAt snehaparimANamAha -
yonimArgeShu nArINAM snehamAtrA dvipAlikI | 
mUtramArge palonmAnA bAlAnAM ca dvikArShikI ||9||

vya_text: gU0 - strINAM bAlAnAM ca snehamAtrApramANamAha - dvipAlikI dvipalapramANA | bAlAnAM dvikArShikI dvikarShamAnA || 9 ||
dI0 - yonyAdimArgatrayaM strINAmeva | kiM tu punarbAlAnAM dvikarShapramANA iti || 9 ||

pada:
atha strINAmuttarabastiH kathaM yojyaH ? ityAha -
uttAnAyai striyai dadyAdUrdhvajAnvai vicakShaNaH | 
apratyAgacCati BiShagbastAvuttarasaMj~jite || 10 ||
BUyo bastiM nidadhyAcca saMyuktaiH SodhanairgaNaiH | 
PalavartiM nidadhyAdvA yonimArge dRuDhAM BiShak || 11|| 
sUtrairvinirmitAM snigdhAM SodhanadravyasaMyutAm | 
dahyamAne tathA bastau dadyAdbastiM viSAradaH || 12 || 
kShIravRukShakaShAyeNa payasA SItalena vA | 
bastiH SukrarujaH puMsAM strINAmArtavajAM rujam|| 13|| 
hanyAduttarabastistu nocito mehinAM kkacit |

vya_text: gU0 - uttAnAyai BiShak dadyAditi saMbandhaH | tathA dadyAt yathA snehaH pratyAgacCati | BUyaH punaH kRucCre viSeShavyAdhau SodhanairgaNaiH eraNDatailAdiBirbastiM nidadhyAt | yonimArge bastyaBAve PalavartikAM nidadhyAt | PalAnAm eraNDabIjAdInAM vartiryadvA PalasadRuSI vartiH PalanAmnI vAsoGanadravyasaMyutasya sUtreNa vinirmitAM punaH snigdhAm evaMBUtA vartiM dadyAt | vartyA dahyamAne bastau mUtrAkASe kShIravRukShakaShAyeNa udumbarAdi punaH payasA SItalena bastiH puMsAM SukradoShajA rujaH strINAm ArtavajA rujaH uttarabastirhanyAt | mehinaH kvacit na ucitaH || 10-13 ||

dI0 - vicakShaNasthAne samAhita iti vA pAThe sa evArthaH | asyAgre - ‘anena vidhinA dadyAt bastIn trIn caturo~api vA’ iti paThanti vyAKyAnayanti ca | anirgame punarbastirdeya ityata Aha - uttarasaMj~jite bastau pratyAgacCati sati BUyaH punarapi bastimuttarasaMj~jaM nidadhyAt | kiMBUtaM ? SodhanairgaNaiH saMyuktam | SodhanagaNo virecanagaNaH | vA athavA PalavartiM nidadhyAt | kva ? yonimArge apatyamArge | kiMBUtAM ? dRuDhAm aSithilAm | ata eva sUtrairvinirmitAm | tathA snigdhAM tathA SodhanadravyasaMyutAm | SodhanadravyakRutAmityarthaH | vartistu agre vakShyamANA j~jAtavyA | asyAgre kecidadhikaM pAThaM paThanti tadyathA --
‘payobastiM nidadhyAttu proktaM gulmacikitsitam | 
praveSayedvA matimAn bastidvAre ca peShaNI ||
pIDayedvApyadho nABerbastinA pariveShTitaH | 
Aragvadhasya patreShu nirguNDyA: svarasasya ca || 
kuryAdgomUtrapiShTeShu vartiM cA~api sasaindhavAm | 
mudgailAsarShapasamAM praviBajya payAMsi ca ||
basterAgamanArthAya tannidadhyAcCalAkayA |’
ityAdipATho bahupustakeShvadarSanAnna vyAKyAtaH | atha bastidAhacikitsAmAha - dravyasyAnirgamAdbastau mUtrASaye dahyamAne sati viSArado vaidyakaSAstrakriyAkuSalaH kShIravRukShakaShAyeNa bastiM dadyAt | vA athavA SItalena payasA bastiM dadyAt | kShIravRukShA vaTodumbarAdayaH | eke kShIravRukShaM rAjAdanamAhuH | rAyaNIti loke | payo~atra pAnIyamAhuH | SItaleti | SItaladravyamadhukAdiyuktatvena SItalena ityarthaH | yaduktaM tantrAntare - ‘SarkarAmadhumiSreNa SItena madhukAmbunA | dahyamAne BiShak bastau pAyau bastiM pradApayet’ iti | athAnantaraM basteH praBAvapUrvakaM niShedhamAha - puMsAM puruShANAM vasAdyASritA rujaH rogAn strINAmArtavajA rujaH asRugdarAdayaH hanyAt | mehinAM pramehiNAM nocitaH na yuktaH | pramehasya bastigatatve~api nocitatvam | yathAnuvAsanaM kuShThapramehinAM niShiddham | kecinmehaSabdena madhumehamAhuH || 10-13 ||

pada:
uttarabasteH snehabastisamAnAyAH guNadoShAnAha -
samyagdattasya li~ggAni vyApadaH krama eva ca || 14 || 
basteruttarasaMj~jasya samAnaM snehabastinA |

vya_text: gU0 – samyagdattalakShaNamAha - SamanaM SukratvaSamanaM Bavati | pramehalakShaNaM SamanaM Bavati || 14 ||

dI0 - uttarasaMj~jasya uttarabasteH snehabastinA~anuvAsanena samAni li~ggAni lakShaNAni tathA vyApadaH hInAtimithyAyogajaH kramaSca upakramaSca samAnaH snehabastinA tulya ityarthaH | tantrAntare tu — ‘duShTaM SukraM SoNitaM cA~gganAnAmasRugdaraM tasya nASaM ca puShpam | mUtrAGAtaM mUtradoShAn pravRuddhAn yonerdoShAn tatparAyASca saMgam | SukrAGAtaM SarkarAmaSmarIM ca SUlaM bastau vaMkShaNe mehane ca | GorAnanyAnbastijAMScApi rogAn mohAdRute uttaro hanti bastiH’ iti || 14 ||

pada:
atha pUrvoddiShTAM PalavartimAha -
GRutAByakte gude kShepyA SlakShNA svA~gguShThasanniBA ||15|| 
malapravartanI vartiH PalavartiSca sA smRutA |
iti SrIdAmodarasUnuSAr~ggadharAcAryapraNItaSAr~ggadhara-
saMhitAyAmuttaraKaNDe uttarabastividhirnAma
saptamo~adhyAyaH || 7 ||

vya_text:
gU0 – PalavartimAha - tatpramANA sA PalavartiH, malapravartanI Bavati | PalAnAM vA nirmitA || 15 || 
iti SrIkASirAmavaidyaviracitAyAM gUDhArthadIpikAyAM
pa~jcakarmaNi uttarabastividhi-
radhyAyaH saptamaH ||

dI0 - SlakShNA komalA, svAMguShThasanniBA AturAMguShThatulyA sthUlatayA | malaM mUtrapurIShAdikam | malaSabdena strINAmapi rajodoShAdikam | apatyamArge deyA IdRuSI PalavartiH smRutA kathitA || 15 ||
iti SrIvAstavyAnvayaprakASavaidyaBAvasiMhAtmajenADhamallena
viracitAyAM SAr~ggadharadIpikAyAM cottaraKaNDe
uttarabastividhiradhyAyaH ||
